name: delphi-to-angular
description: Guide the conversion of Polypoint P2 Delphi VCL forms (.dfm/.pas) and frames into Angular standalone components — analyzing DFM/PAS sources, mapping VCL components (TForm, TFrame, TDBGrid, TVirtualStringTree, TPanel, TPageControl, etc.) to Angular + @pdx/* equivalents, extracting business rules from Delphi code, Oracle procedures, and DB constraints into rule cards enforced in the MSW handlers handed to the backend team, and emitting PDX-styled feature components with NgRx Signal Store and Signal Forms.
